scene.meaning: Active holographic material (panel swap, program, spectral tables, print text)

Object carrying the foil: the card, a bent card, a rippled sheet, crumpled foil, a can label, a sphere, a torus (A1.1), the Holo cloth, the sticker wall (A13), a flag on a pole in the wind (A14) or your own GLB / glTF model (A3)

Inert since UI v2: the orbit view is always on unless the view is frozen (drag empty space to orbit, Space or right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom). Kept so saved versions, views, links (orbit=0/1) and stored settings that carry it load unchanged
The orbit view: smoothing while dragging and momentum after release (a flick keeps spinning and coasts to a stop); 0 = direct

Automatic motion: idle wobble, the first-load pose, idle micro-motion, the spring back to rest after a drag and, on the sticker wall, the hover tilt. Off = the object only moves when you drag it and stays exactly where you leave it
Depth of field: a thin-lens camera blur on the HDR image (bokeh from glints, near/far layering); off = no pass at all
Aperture f-number N (the lens's third-stop series): entrance pupil A = f/N, CoC ∝ A

Focus distance from the camera (manual focus only)

Page colour and the §5.2 lighting adaptation (exposure, fill, camera side, backdrop, panel theme); Colour: the colour below, the adaptation scaled by its lightness
The page colour of background Colour (picking one switches the background to Colour)

Flag: freezes the flag where it is — no simulation, no redraw, no pulling (a drag tilts instead)
Flag: how fast its world runs — 1 real time, 0.25 four times slower (slow motion), 2 twice as fast: the same motion, slowed or sped up (a frozen view's moment does not depend on it)
